original_test_intent: Verify the eight `TEMP_GB_GPU1_M` through `TEMP_GB_GPU8_M` records—presumptively one module-channel temperature associated with each GPU position—are individually readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with correct GPU identity, measurement-point meaning, value, units, status and supported thresholds.
original_method: Confirm GB/GPU/`_M` terminology, resolve eight stable BMC records, bind each index to a physical GPU position and stable GPU UUID/BDF plus the exact BMC temperature source, then compare complete passive raw/UI fields with the applicable measurement-point limits under recorded GPU power/load and cooling. Preserve logs and GPU state.
manual_activity: The platform owner defines `_M`, maps GPU1-8 to physical positions and stable UUID/BDF identities, identifies each BMC measurement point and supplies its limits. Automation can collect eight BMC records, passive GPU inventory and UI rows; a human resolves suffix/source ambiguity and owns the verdict. No GPU workload, reset, power change or service is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and authoritative GB/GPU/`_M` naming definition
Per-index physical GPU position, board reference, GPU PN/serial/UUID/BDF/firmware and present/absent/power-state matrix
Exact meaning of the temperature field—module, die, memory, board or other—and its sensor part/source
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and stable SDR plus Dashboard/Server Health identity for each record
Measurement-point-specific units, scaling, tolerance, thresholds/hysteresis, status, polling and unavailable/stale rules
Recorded GPU driver/persistence/power/load state, fan speeds, inlet/airflow and optional approved equivalent GPU telemetry field
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser versions and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel, NVIDIA XID or thermal logs; they are relevant context.
Do not issue `sensor get 'TEMP_GB_GPU1_M~TEMP_GB_GPU8_M'` as a wildcard. Enumerate and query all eight exact records.
Do not infer GPU number from BDF order, `nvidia-smi` index or physical slot without the approved stable map, and do not interpret `_M` as memory merely from its letter.
Host GPU telemetry may corroborate only after exact measurement-point equivalence is approved; a die or HBM value does not automatically equal a BMC module/board sensor.
Do not start GPU workload, enable persistence, reset/power-cycle/reseat a GPU, alter fans/thresholds or flash firmware. Record the existing passive state and defined absent-device behavior.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on missing/duplicate/swapped sensors, stale data or BMC/UI/GPU disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate `_M` meaning, eight-position physical/GPU/BMC-source map, target, client and Script; build an eight-row expectation matrix before collection.
Retrieve GPU1_M through GPU8_M independently with full SDR identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture each unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row.
Correlate each record with physical GPU, stable UUID/BDF and recorded present/power/load/cooling state; use host GPU telemetry only when its exact field equivalence is approved.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, GPU load/reset/power/service, driver/persistence, fan/threshold/firmware change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Define `_M` and approve the GPU index, physical position, stable identity and BMC measurement-source map.
Provide measurement-point-specific thermal limits, tolerance, threshold/status/freshness and absent-device rules; approve any telemetry equivalence and collection tool/Script.
Review all eight records independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting one GPU, a different GPU temperature field or aggregate health.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as written because the range expression is not an IPMI wildcard and one response cannot prove eight GPU_M records. It omits suffix/measurement-point/GPU/BMC-source and UI/spec mapping, truncates fallback data, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete sensors, confirm all eight physical GPU identities and `_M` measurement sources, query every vendor-supported record through protected read-only access, and correlate eight UI rows with the approved GPU matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_GB_GPU1_M through TEMP_GB_GPU8_M, both WebUI paths, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the range without editing Master or applying workload.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an eight-row matrix keyed by physical GPU position, stable UUID/BDF and exact `_M` BMC measurement point, then compare complete raw/API and UI fields with field-specific limits under recorded passive GPU/cooling state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact eight-GPU baseboard population and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, GPU VBIOS/firmware/driver, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: GPU-baseboard population/index map, GPU inventory, BMC management-bus/sensor definition, GPU/module thermal specification, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the compound range into eight stable GPU-identity and measurement-point-bound records while preserving passive display coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static display does not validate GPU workload response, die/HBM telemetry unless `_M` is proven equivalent, throttling, power capping, threshold events, fan control or protection actions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Suffix definition, eight-GPU identity/BMC-source map, per-field acceptance, passive-state timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU enumeration can change across boots and BMC labels may follow physical positions; `_M` can denote a sensor class different from die or memory telemetry, and UI values may lag.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or NVIDIA telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/field and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent separate GPU1_M-8_M identity, measurement point, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. `nvidia-smi` temperature is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS, authoritative `_M` definition and eight-row physical position, GPU PN/serial/UUID/BDF/firmware/presence/power-state matrix
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact temperature field plus stable SDR/UI identity for every GPU_M record
Complete separate raw records with values, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamps plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health rows
Measurement-point-specific Project/vendor comparison and recorded GPU driver/persistence/power/load, fan/inlet/airflow state with approved telemetry equivalence if any

Explicit missing/duplicate/swapped/stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-load/no-reset-or-service/no-retry proof, final GPU/BMC health and engineer-owned eight-record verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `_M` is undefined and the compound range is unsuitable as one query, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation of eight GPU-associated temperature records. Exact suffix and field mapping are readiness inputs, not conflicting purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eight-record GPU-associated thermal-display purpose is identifiable. Project SPEC can define `_M`, stable GPU mapping and acceptance, so missing execution inputs do not permanently block the review.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed compound range query, unstable GPU index or unrelated die/HBM value from being presented as eight GPU_M records, and prevents GPU stress or resets from being added to a passive Sensor Page test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The paired temperature and power `GPU*_M` names suggest a per-GPU module channel, but do not prove whether `_M` means module, memory or another vendor field. Because GPU indices are unstable across software views, each BMC record needs a physical position plus UUID/BDF and an exact measurement-source definition. Passive display coverage cannot justify GPU workload or threshold stimulus.
